title: App has ruined my phone calendar by adding blank events that I can't delete
body:
I am very suspicious of this app. I have contacted the helpline for advice but haven't heard back. Very disappointed!!
As a response the developer then asked (below) that I get back in contact, even though I had sent 2 emails over a week ago and the response time is meant to be within 48 hours. If they can't find those emails I'm afraid I'm not inclined to waste any more time myself having spent many, many hours on the phone to apple support, who finally managed to restore my phone. Needless to say I have deleted the app. I strongly recommend anyone contemplating this app to NOT download it. I've never left a bad app review before and have never had so many problems because of an app.
